properties.site-address: East of Bridge of Aln Hotel, Whittingham
properties.notes: Site of former railway station although somewhat isolated from the wider settlement. Rural location but opportunity for potential redevelopment of limited part of large site. The reduced yield indicated recognises potential suitability for small scale development of 15 units. The site has been the subject to other small-scale projects on discreet parts of the site. This includes renovation of the listed railway station to form a single dwelling and redevelopment of engine shed to form a further dwelling (11/00726/FUL). This has been commenced but not yet completed. Another application was permitted for conversion of the goods shed to a dwelling (14/02689/FUL).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
